                        else self.previous_spy_ma

                    if self.rsi_average_gain is None:
                        self.rsi_average_gain = 0
                        self.rsi_average_loss = 0

                    self.rsi_average_loss += loss

                        self.rsi_average_loss /= 14
                        self.aapl_rsi = self._calculate_rsi()

                    self.rsi_average_loss = ((self.rsi_average_loss * 13) + loss) / 14
                    self.aapl_rsi = self._calculate_rsi()

        rs = self.rsi_average_gain / self.rsi_average_loss
        return 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))

    def _rules_ready(self):

            len(self.spy_closes) == self.MA_PERIOD
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_ma is not None
            and self.aapl_rsi is not None
        )
